closingReference.boundaryRule: latest finalized slot whose blockTime is less than or equal to the published close timestamp

rules.scoring: floor(min(net balance increase, net bought from the official pool) / 25000)

drawContract.seedSource: a finalized Solana block strictly later than public publication of this closing snapshot
drawContract.selection: sort all tickets lexicographically; award fixed-order prizes to the first ticket owned by a wallet that has not already won

excludedMarketMaking.reason: automated high-frequency trading wallet; excluded under the campaign's published market-making exclusion
automated high-frequency trading wallet; excluded under the campaign's published market-making exclusion

audit.reconstructionRule: closing raw balance equals the current DAS aggregate balance minus every owner-level mint delta after the exact closing slot; current token accounts and any post-close accounts discovered through owner-signed transactions are included
